line: Crowley's Princess of Cups: the Hé final of the Name, the earthy part of Water, and a quadrant of the heavens that the table alone names.

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley names the Princesses by the Hé final of the Name.

quotes.quote: The Princesses represent the Hé final of the Name.
The Princess of Cups represents the earthy part of Water; in particular, the faculty of crystallization.

sections.title: Its place in the heavens
sections.line: Princesses have no zodiacal attribution. The attribution table names a quadrant of the heavens for her (pdf p274); the text names none, so no quotation stands for it.

quotes.quote: The Princesses have no Zodiacal attribution.

sections.title: Its character as Crowley describes it
sections.line: Crowley's description of the figure and the card, in his own words.

quotes.quote: The character of the Princess is infinitely gracious.
